guard-bash-backgrounded-verification.summary: PreToolUse(Bash): denies a backgrounded verification-set run (run_in_background, `&`, nohup).

guard-bash-pr-body-rewrite.summary: PreToolUse(Bash): denies a raw PR-body rewrite that would drop the authored-by stamp.

session-reaper-backstop.summary: The reaper writes a backstop terminal record for a reaped review/fix session that never reported done.

deliver-item-wrapper-no-report.summary: The v2 delivery wrapper treats an agent exit with no `done` report as a crash and surfaces it.

review-independence.summary: Refuses a proven self-clear (the PR's author clearing its own review).
